cost_per_extra_correct_usd.from: results/eval/v1_test.json (its difference and confusion tables), v1_dev.json and v1_dev.csv
cost_per_extra_correct_usd.note: each run's cost per 1,000 complaints over its lead in re-weighted points per 1,000, against TF-IDF at the same coverage (the headline rule, B10) and against TF-IDF labelling every complaint. A lead in re-weighted points only approximates extra correct labels per 1,000

hybrid.hybrid_llm_cost_assumes: every complaint costs the same to label, so the LLM's cost falls by the share TF-IDF answers
hybrid.is: exploratory and optimistic: the prompt was tuned on this set, the 0.9 threshold was fixed on 2 November, after the development results were published on 29 October, and no untouched test set is left to check it

time_at_scale.assumes: the test run's calls, sent one at a time, run this many at a time, with no rate limit
